scan.fidelity_claim: records participant discovery timing without claiming portable wall-clock fidelity

preconditions.description: scan may start only inside the scenario maintenance window
backend can realize the scan action contract

effects.description: terminal scan observation is emitted for the participant

temporal_contracts.description: scan is eligible only during the authored maintenance window
temporal_contracts.ordering_basis: participant schedule relation, not raw timestamp causality

temporal_contracts.description: scan attempts are rate-limited per participant episode
temporal_contracts.reset_boundary: participant episode reset starts a new cadence segment
temporal_contracts.replay_boundary: replay preserves the original cadence segment id

temporal_contracts.description: backend must realize the scan before the participant timeout
temporal_contracts.reset_boundary: participant episode reset clears the deadline state
temporal_contracts.replay_boundary: replay reports the original deadline state

temporal_contracts.description: target service must remain in scope for the scan dwell window
temporal_contracts.reset_boundary: participant episode reset clears dwell accumulation

temporal_contracts.description: terminal observation latency is measured from submit to observation delivery
temporal_contracts.reset_boundary: participant episode reset closes the latency segment

temporal_contracts.description: study-level collection window for participant attempts
temporal_contracts.reset_boundary: participant episode reset does not change the study window
temporal_contracts.replay_boundary: replay reports the original study window
temporal_contracts.randomization_basis: study coordinator seed and cohort assignment

backend_timing_disclosures.description: remote backend pacing is best-effort and not portable semantic time
limitations: wall-clock pacing may lag backend event time

backend_timing_disclosures.description: backend serializes scan realization before emitting terminal observation
limitations: serialized order is disclosed as realized order
